text: Ambiguity [Lat. ambo + agere , to act]: Ger. Zweideut gkeit ; Fr. ambiguïté ; Ital. ambiguità . A source of verbal fallacy, depending on the fact that the same word or words may have come historically to bear more than one sense, or may have a meaning that varies with the context. See FALLACY. ( R.A. )
